row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (priced by employee count, product and service tier; billed annually)
row.evidence: Culture Amp includes "SSO & encryption" on every plan, and its SSO guide says IdP gallery connectors are not supported. Employee records come from HRIS, API or SFTP sync, or a CSV/XLSX import. No SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). SAML SSO is self-service on all subscriptions, through a custom SAML app in Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, OneLogin or Ping. Gallery and OIN connectors are explicitly unsupported. Okta's old OIN entry is SWA only. Users are provisioned from employee data (native HRIS integrations, an HRIS API for ADP/UKG/SAP and others, SFTP, or a manual XLSX/CSV import), not from the IdP. The public API is read-only (employees, demographics, performance data) and included at no extra cost. Pricing is quote-only by employee count, module (Engage, Perform) and service tier, billed annually. The pricing URL now redirects to /platform/plans-and-pricing. June's claim that Culture Amp 'does not support SCIM by design' has no first-party source, so it is dropped; the none status rests on absence across the pricing page, the help-centre sitemap and the API reference.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence: no SCIM article in the help-centre sitemap (493 URLs), no SCIM in the API reference index, and the SSO guides rule out IdP gallery connectors.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Scopes take the form target-entity:<entity_id>:<permission>.

capabilities.notes: Write capabilities are false because the API is documented as outbound retrieval only.

rate_limits.text: Client-based and service-based throttling; 429/503 on limit. Response payloads are capped at about 1MB, after which results are paginated.

limitations.text: Read-only: the API cannot create, update or deactivate employees.

okta.notes: OIN entry is SWA only (page markup, last updated Jan. 30 2015). Culture Amp's guide requires a custom SAML app, so SAML SSO works but not via the catalogue app.

entra.notes: Non-gallery enterprise app per Culture Amp's guide; gallery app unsupported.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per Culture Amp's guide.

onelogin.notes: Culture Amp publishes a OneLogin SAML guide.

fallbacks.other_sync: Native HRIS integrations (Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, Personio and others), HRIS API connectors (ADP, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors and others) and SFTP
